Gnosis Interpretation
MOVE below 80 is calm, 80-120 is moderate uncertainty, and 150+ is high stress; 97.92 is moderate. SOFR is secured overnight funding, not unsecured bank funding. NFCI below zero indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions; -0.459 is the latest weekly observation for Oct 30, not a live reading.

Fed & Policy Watch
  • The Board's November calendar lists FOMC minutes for the Oct 27-28 meeting on Nov 18 at 2:00 PM ET and Beige Book on Nov 25 at 2:00 PM ET. The December Board calendar confirms the Dec 8-9 meeting, with statement/decision Dec 9 at 2:00 PM and press conference at 2:30 PM ET.
  • Selected Board statistical releases: H.15 and H.8 today at 4:15 PM; H.15 Nov 12 at 4:15 PM; H.4.1 Nov 12 at 4:30 PM; and H.8 Nov 13 at 4:15 PM. Each was matched to its own date list. The Board calendar shows no FOMC policy decision in November.
  • Funding and conditions are lagged: SOFR 3.94% effective Nov 4, NFCI -0.459 for the week ending Oct 30, MOVE 97.92 and the official 10-year Treasury close 4.84% on Nov 5.
Omissions and Watch
  • Conflict check: the NY Fed November calendar places Personal Income and the PCE Deflator on Nov 25 at 8:30 AM without a period. BEA schedules GDP (Second Estimate) and Corporate Profits for Q3 on Nov 25, but Personal Income and Outlays for October on Dec 2. The discrepancy is unresolved; both publisher entries are retained separately, without assuming they are the same dated release.
  • Calendar cutoff and holiday check: all displayed rows are strictly later than Fri Nov 6, 12:30:39 AM ET. The EIA petroleum schedule moves the report for the week ending Nov 6 to Thu Nov 12 at noon; the natural gas schedule moves its Veterans Day report to Fri Nov 13 at 10:30 AM. The normal Thursday gas release is already elapsed; no elapsed event is carried forward.
  • BLS.gov was not requested; the New York Fed Economic Indicators Calendar is the cited source for BLS dates and ET times. Chicago Fed CARTS is listed from its release calendar; the Chicago Fed NFCI CSV returned observations through Oct 30. No Chicago Fed timed item was otherwise inferred.
  • Unmatched classifier events (CARTS, Michigan preliminary survey, Initial Claims, and Industrial Production) are provisional Medium and flagged in their rows for review. The impact self-test passed; no overrides used. CPI is High and PPI is Medium.
  • Selected calendar rows only; routine releases and other auction activity are not exhaustive. No independently verified unscheduled policy or geopolitical watch item was established in this run; this is not a full headline-risk review. Market volatility has risen in the latest vendor bars. Review live event updates, liquidity and contract specifications before execution.
  • Sources checked: New York Fed November Economic Indicators Calendar and SOFR; Federal Reserve Board November and December calendars, FOMC calendar and H.4.1; Chicago Fed release calendar and NFCI data; BEA schedule; Census 2026 indicator calendar; Philadelphia Fed; NAR; TreasuryDirect auctions; EIA petroleum and natural gas schedules; U.S. Treasury daily yield curve; Yahoo Finance charts. Charts are single-source vendor quotes, not official settlements.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Elevated, event-sensitive two-way risk: SPY fell 4.41% Thursday and VIX rose to 28.18, while MOVE at 97.92 remains in the moderate-uncertainty band. ES=F is near the prior daily bar in early Friday trade and the official 10Y close eased 6 bp to 4.84%. Employment Situation and Chicago CARTS arrive at 8:30 AM, followed by Michigan sentiment at 10:00 AM. Avoid assuming overnight stability is confirmation; let price, rates and breadth establish direction after the data. Scenario framing only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if rates reverse sharply with expanding volatility, the labor/CPI data materially reprice policy expectations, or ES moves without confirmation from rates, breadth or depth. No unsupported levels or targets are supplied. Verify the intended contract, current event updates and fresh quotes before execution.
